title: Evolving Memory, Learning to Meta-Control: Test-Time Adaptation for Experience-augmented LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.01747v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-evolving agents accumulate experience from task streams, but existing frameworks typically rely on fixed pipelines to retrieve and utilize this experience, neglecting when and how to deploy it. We introduce Online Meta-Control of Experience (OMCE), a framework that updates experience memory and learns a meta-control policy from task feedback during test-time adaptation. OMCE employs a lightweight contextual-bandit meta-controller that uses compact retrieval signals to select among four cognitive actions: DIRECT, EPISODE, GUIDE, and DISTILL. This routing mechanism operationalizes three coupled decisions: whether to invoke experience, which memory format to utilize, and when to consolidate new guidance. OMCE evolves online, leveraging task feedback to update the memory bank and refine the routing policy via contextual bandit updates. Experiments on four online adaptation benchmarks across four backbones show that OMCE improves first

translated_title: 演化记忆，学习元控制：面向经验增强型LLM智能体的测试时自适应
translated_abstract: 自演化智能体能够从任务流中积累经验，但现有框架通常依赖固定的流程来检索和利用这些经验，忽视了何时以及如何部署经验。我们提出了经验在线元控制（Online Meta-Control of Experience, OMCE）框架，该框架在测试时自适应过程中更新经验记忆，并从任务反馈中学习元控制策略。OMCE采用轻量级的上下文老虎机元控制器，利用紧凑的检索信号在四种认知动作中进行选择：DIRECT（直接）、EPISODE（情节）、GUIDE（引导）和DISTILL（蒸馏）。这一路由机制实现了三个相互耦合的决策：是否调用经验、使用哪种记忆格式、以及何时固化新的引导。OMCE在线演化，利用任务反馈更新记忆库，并通过上下文老虎机更新来改进路由策略。在四个在线自适应基准和四个主干模型上的实验表明，OMCE提升了首次……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出了OMCE框架，通过轻量级上下文老虎机元控制器在测试时自适应过程中动态决定是否及如何调用和固化经验记忆，实现了LLM智能体经验的在线演化与最优部署。
en_tdlr: OMCE introduces a lightweight contextual-bandit meta-controller that dynamically decides whether, which format, and when to deploy experience memory during test-time adaptation, enabling online evolution of experience-augmented LLM agents.
